entry.title: 3' Royal Fir Tabletop Tree with 100 Warm White LED Lights
entry.summary:
Vendor: King of Christmas
Type: Tabletop
Price: 119.00

Why settle for less this holiday season when you can celebrate in grand style. Add a breathtaking Christmas tree to your home decor when you choose the Royal Fir to grace your home this holiday season. This stunning and magnificent Christmas tree is full-bodied and features realistic foliage that creates a beautiful and lifelike display. The Royal Fir is one of our hallmark signature trees and features a high-end design for the ultimate Christmas tree display. The 3' Royal Fir is a miniature version of our Royal Fir Tree. Using the same tips and structure to give the tree a full-bodied and realistic look. The base is made of porcelain and resembles a wooden tree stump. Round out your Christmas collection this holiday season with the 3' Royal Fir tree.

entry.title: 3' Queen Flock® Artificial Christmas Tabletop Tree with 50 Warm White LED Lights
entry.summary:
Vendor: King of Christmas
Type: Tabletop
Price: 79.00

No Christmas setting is complete without at least one tabletop tree! A scaled down version of our signature flock collection, the small but mighty Queen Flock mini Christmas tree sits perfectly on any tabletop, fireplace hearth, or anywhere else that needs a “little” Christmas spirit. 3 feet tall and 18” wide, this portable beauty can easily be moved around anywhere for quick and easy redecorating. Plus, with a blend of realistic and classic needle tips combined with handmade heavily flocked branches, you and your loved ones will get to enjoy the magical feeling of freshly fallen snow in the warmth of your own home. For added convenience, this elegant garland has been expertly pre-strung with 50 warm white LED lights, which are battery operated for a clean and seamless accent that won’t use up your outlets and can be placed virtually anywhere!

entry.title: 3' King Flock® Artificial Christmas Tabletop Tree with 50 Warm White LED Lights
entry.summary:
Vendor: King of Christmas
Type: Tabletop
Price: 74.00

Just admit it, we all know why you're here. You might have seen it at a friend's place, or perhaps your cousin won't quit it with how stunning theirs looks, or maybe you're checking in to see if all that Instagram hype is real. Well, without further ado, we present the 3' King Flock mini tree. With a natural-colored burlap base, the 3' King Flock tree is a scaled-down version of the king flock without compromising on the quality or details of the tree.

The King Flock Christmas tree is one of our premier signature trees. It features state of the art design with a blend of realistic tips (PE) and classic tips (PVC) resulting in a grand and beautiful hallmark Christmas tree. With heavily flocked tips, you can enjoy the look of freshly fallen snow adorning each branch of your tree. So let it snow this holiday season while you sip eggnog, and marvel at this wonderland masterpiece.
